relationships.evidence_quote: CBD has been shown to elicit moderate GABA enhancing (PAM) effects on α1β1, α2β1, α1β2, α2β2, α1β1γ2, α2β1γ2, α1β2γ2 and α2β2γ2

relationships.subject: cannabidiol
relationships.evidence_quote: CBD and Δ9-THC are potentiating glycine effects in native spinal neurons, as well as in recombinant α1 and α1β1 GlyRs

relationships.subject: cannabidiol
relationships.evidence_quote: CBD has been identified as NAM of α7-nAChRs at micromolar concentrations in whole-cell patch clamp recordings in rat hippocampal slices
